[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In right-angled ΔBDC, the sum of acute angles is 90°.

∠C = 90° − ∠DBC = 90° − 80° = 10°.

In ΔAEC, the exterior angle ∠AEB is equal to the sum of the opposite interior angles.

∠AEB = ∠CAE + ∠C

∠AEB = 37° + 10° = 47°.

**∴ The correct answer is 47°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

BD ⊥ AC at D, so ∠BDC = 90°

∠DBC = 80°

∠CAE = 37°

E is a point on line BC.

**Formula Used:**

Sum of angles in a triangle = 180°

Exterior Angle Theorem: The exterior angle of a triangle equals the sum of the two opposite interior angles.

 
 
• 
• 
 
 
 
 
 A D C B E 37° 80° 10° ? 

**Calculations:**

⇒ In ΔBDC, the sum of all interior angles is 180°.

⇒ ∠DBC + ∠BDC + ∠C = 180°

⇒ 80° + 90° + ∠C = 180°

⇒ ∠C = 180° − 170° = 10°

⇒ Now consider ΔAEC. Since E lies on the line segment BC, side CE is extended to point B.

⇒ By the Exterior Angle Theorem, the exterior angle at vertex E equals the sum of the two interior opposite angles.

⇒ ∠AEB = ∠CAE + ∠C

⇒ ∠AEB = 37° + 10°

⇒ ∠AEB = 47°

**∴ The correct answer is 47°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Exterior Angle Theorem

The measure of an exterior angle of a triangle is exactly equal to the sum of the measures of its two remote interior opposite angles.

Angle Sum Property of a Triangle

The sum of all interior angles of any planar triangle is invariably equal to 180°.

Right-Angled Triangle Rules

In any right-angled triangle, the two acute angles are complementary, meaning their combined sum naturally evaluates to 90°.

questions.question:
Simplify the given expression.
 (5x + 3y)² - (5x - 3y)²
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The given expression is in the standard form (a + b)² − (a − b)².

We know the direct algebraic identity: (a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab

Here, substitute a = 5x and b = 3y.

⇒ 4 × (5x) × (3y)

⇒ 60xy

**∴ The correct answer is 60xy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: (5x + 3y)² − (5x − 3y)²

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

(a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²

**Calculations:**

Step 1: Expand the first term.

⇒ (5x + 3y)² = (5x)² + 2(5x)(3y) + (3y)² = 25x² + 30xy + 9y²

Step 2: Expand the second term.

⇒ (5x − 3y)² = (5x)² − 2(5x)(3y) + (3y)² = 25x² − 30xy + 9y²

Step 3: Subtract the second expression from the first expression.

⇒ (25x² + 30xy + 9y²) − (25x² − 30xy + 9y²)

⇒ 25x² + 30xy + 9y² − 25x² + 30xy − 9y²

⇒ 30xy + 30xy

⇒ 60xy

**∴ The correct answer is 60xy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Squares Identity

If we add the expressions instead of subtracting, the formula is: (a + b)² + (a − b)² = 2(a² + b²).

Difference of Squares

A very useful formula for factorisation is: a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b).

Cubic Identities

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b) and (a − b)³ = a³ − b³ − 3ab(a − b).

questions.question: In an election, there were 12,000 voters. In the first round, Babita received 40% of the votes, and Ramanlal received 35% of the votes. The remaining votes went to other candidates. In the second round, Babita gained 20% more votes compared to the first round, while Ramanlal gained 10% more votes. How many votes did Babita receive in the second round?
questions.solution:

Babita first round = 40% of 12000 = 4800

Second round increase = 20% ⇒ multiply by 1.2

New votes = 4800 × 1.2

= 5760

**∴ Answer = 5760**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total voters = 12000, Babita got 40% in first round and then 20% more votes

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (part / whole) × 100 and increase = original × (1 + rate)

**Calculation:**

⇒ First round votes of Babita = 40% of 12000

⇒ = (40/100) × 12000 = 4800

⇒ Increase = 20% of 4800 = 960

⇒ Second round votes = 4800 + 960

⇒ = 5760

**∴ The correct answer is 5760.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Increase

Basic Percentage

x% of y = (x/100) × y

Successive Change

When values increase in stages, apply percentage on the latest value.

Quick Multiplier Trick

questions.question: Rama made necklaces with either 24 beads, 36 beads or 40 beads, such that no bead was left over. What is the least number of beads Rama could have?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Find LCM of 24, 36, and 40

Prime factors: 24 = 2³×3, 36 = 2²×3², 40 = 2³×5

LCM = 2³ × 3² × 5 = 8 × 9 × 5

= 360

**∴ Answer = 360**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Necklaces can be made using 24, 36, or 40 beads with no remainder

**Formula used:**

Least number = LCM of given numbers

**Calculation:**

⇒ 24 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3

⇒ 36 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 3

⇒ 40 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 5

⇒ Take highest powers: 2³, 3², 5

⇒ LCM = 2³ × 3² × 5

⇒ = 8 × 9 × 5

⇒ = 360

**∴ The correct answer is 360.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM (Least Common Multiple)

The smallest number divisible by all given numbers.

Prime Factorization Method

Break numbers into primes and take highest powers.

Application

Used when items must be grouped equally without leftovers.

HCF vs LCM

LCM is for minimum common multiple, while HCF is for maximum common divisor.

questions.question: If 5.12 × 50625 × 0.5488 = 2^a 3^b 5^c 7^d , then find the value of a + b + c + d.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert decimals: 5.12 = 512/100, 0.5488 = 5488/10000

Write in primes: 512 = 2⁹, 5488 = 2⁴×7³, 50625 = 3⁴×5⁴

Denominator: 100 × 10000 = 2⁶×5⁶

Combine powers ⇒ 2⁷ 3⁴ 5⁻² 7³

**∴ Answer = a + b + c + d = 12**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

5.12 × 50625 × 0.5488 = 2a 3b 5c 7d

**Formula used:**

Convert decimals to fractions and use prime factorization with exponent rules

**Calculation:**

⇒ 5.12 = 512/100 = 2⁹ / (2²×5²) = 2⁷×5⁻²

⇒ 50625 = 81 × 625 = 3⁴×5⁴

⇒ 0.5488 = 5488/10000 = (2⁴×7³) / (2⁴×5⁴) = 7³×5⁻⁴

⇒ Multiply all: 2⁷ × 3⁴ × 5⁻² × 5⁴ × 7³ × 5⁻⁴

⇒ = 2⁷ × 3⁴ × 5⁻²⁺⁴⁻⁴ × 7³

⇒ = 2⁷ × 3⁴ × 5⁻² × 7³

⇒ So a = 7, b = 4, c = -2, d = 3

⇒ a + b + c + d = 7 + 4 − 2 + 3 = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Decimal Conversion

Prime Factorization

Laws of Exponents

am × aⁿ = am⁺ⁿ, and a⁻ⁿ = 1/aⁿ

questions.question: Simplify : (1 - (1)/(costheta)) ( (1 + sectheta)/(tan²theta) )
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identities: secθ = 1/cosθ and tan²θ = sec²θ − 1

(1 − 1/cosθ) = (cosθ − 1)/cosθ and (1 + secθ) = (1 + 1/cosθ)

Convert everything in terms of cosθ

After simplification, expression reduces neatly

**∴ Answer = −1**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(1 − 1/cosθ) ( (1 + secθ)/tan²θ )

**Formula used:**

secθ = 1/cosθ, tan²θ = (1 − cos²θ)/cos²θ

**Calculation:**

⇒ Replace secθ = 1/cosθ

⇒ = (1 − 1/cosθ) × ((1 + 1/cosθ)/tan²θ)

⇒ = ((cosθ − 1)/cosθ) × ((cosθ + 1)/cosθ) × (1/tan²θ)

⇒ = (cos²θ − 1)/cos²θ × (1/tan²θ)

⇒ = (−sin²θ)/cos²θ × (cos²θ/sin²θ)

⇒ = −1

**∴ The correct answer is −1.**

secθ = 1/cosθ and tanθ = sinθ/cosθ

Pythagorean Identity

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1

Derived Identity

tan²θ = sin²θ / cos²θ

Simplification Tip

Convert all terms into sine and cosine for easier cancellation.

questions.question: If the fourth proportional to P, 22 and 8 is 11, then find the value of P.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a proportion a : b :: c : d, the product of extremes equals the product of means.

P × 11 = 22 × 8

P = 176 ÷ 11

P = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The first three terms are P, 22, and 8.

The fourth proportional is 11.

**Formula Used:**

If a, b, c, and d are in proportion, then a/b = c/d.

 P : 22 :: 8 : 11 
 Product of Means = 22 × 8 
 Product of Extremes = P × 11 

**Calculations:**

⇒ P / 22 = 8 / 11

⇒ P = (22 × 8) ÷ 11

⇒ P = 2 × 8

⇒ P = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Third Proportional

If c is the third proportional to a and b, then a : b :: b : c, giving the formula c = b² ÷ a.

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional (or geometric mean) between two numbers a and b is given by √(a × b).

First Proportional

If a is the first proportional to b, c, and d, then a : b :: c : d, which gives a = (b × c) ÷ d.

Continued Proportion

Three numbers a, b, and c are said to be in continued proportion if a : b :: b : c.

questions.question: A mother's age is double her son's age at present. If the difference of their ages after 24 years from now is 20, then find their ages at present (in years), respectively.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Age difference remains constant always

After 24 years difference = 20 ⇒ present difference also = 20

Mother = 2 × Son ⇒ difference = Son

So Son = 20 and Mother = 40

**∴ Answer = 40 years and 20 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mother's age = 2 × Son's age and difference after 24 years = 20

**Formula used:**

Age difference remains constant and linear equations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let son's present age = x

⇒ Mother's present age = 2x

⇒ After 24 years: Son = x + 24, Mother = 2x + 24

⇒ Difference = (2x + 24) − (x + 24)

⇒ = x

⇒ Given difference = 20 ⇒ x = 20

⇒ Mother's age = 2x = 40

**∴ The correct answer is 40 years and 20 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Difference Rule

The difference between ages of two people remains constant over time.

Linear Equations

Age problems can be solved using simple algebraic expressions.

Future Age Concept

After n years, add n to present ages.

Ratio Insight

If one age is double, difference equals the smaller age.

questions.question: Walking (5)/(8) of his normal speed from his home, Tarun is 21 minutes late in reaching his office. The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home and his office is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed ratio = (5/8) ⇒ time ratio = (8/5)

Extra time = (8/5 − 1) = 3/5 of usual time

3/5 of usual time = 21 minutes

Usual time = 21 × (5/3)

**∴ Answer = 35 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Reduced speed = (5/8) of normal speed and delay = 21 minutes

**Formula used:**

Time ∝ 1/Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let usual speed = 8 units, reduced speed = 5 units

⇒ Then time ratio = 8 : 5 (inverse of speed)

⇒ Extra time = 8 − 5 = 3 units

⇒ These 3 units correspond to 21 minutes

⇒ 1 unit = 21/3 = 7 minutes

⇒ Usual time = 5 units = 5 × 7 = 35 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 35 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed-Time Relation

For fixed distance, Speed × Time = constant

Inverse Proportion

If speed decreases, time increases proportionally.

Ratio Trick

Convert speed ratio to time ratio by taking inverse.

Shortcut Formula

Extra time = (difference in time ratio / smaller ratio) × actual time

Total days from 20 Feb to 21 Apr in a leap year = 9 (Feb) + 31 (Mar) + 21 (Apr) = 61 days.

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

⇒ Number of days counted in April = 21 days.

What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

 29 div 13 + 545 times 5 - 317 = ?

Transform the signs: ÷ → ×, + → −, × → ÷, − → +

Rewritten Equation: 29 × 13 − 545 ÷ 5 + 317

Result: 268 + 317 = 585

⇒ New Equation: 29 × 13 − 545 ÷ 5 + 317

⇒ Perform Division: 545 ÷ 5 = 109

⇒ Perform Multiplication: 29 × 13 = 377

⇒ Updated Expression: 377 − 109 + 317

⇒ Perform Subtraction: 377 − 109 = 268

⇒ Perform Addition: 268 + 317 = 585

**∴ The correct answer is 585.**

BODMAS Rule

It defines the sequence for solving multi-operator equations: Brackets, Orders (powers/roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Mathematical Reasoning Sign Interchange

Always rewrite the entire expression with the new signs before starting calculations to avoid errors in the order of operations.

VBODMAS Rule

V stands for Vinculum (bar bracket), which must be solved even before standard brackets ().
